description: Address review issues 1-6: fix circuit breaker cooldown enforcement, load circuit breaker state at startup, restrict env vars leaked to CLI subprocesses, clean up temp workspaces on terminate, refactor _build_args dispatch into CLIBackendInfo, and document guardrail module deprecation plan.
steps: Fix PersistentCircuitBreaker.is_open() to check cooldown_seconds and auto-close expired circuits
Add PersistentCircuitBreaker.load_state() call in app lifespan
Add env var filtering in CLIAdapter._do_execute to strip sensitive keys not needed by backends
Add shutil.rmtree cleanup of temp workspaces in CLIAdapter._do_terminate
Add deprecation docstring note to src/nexus/governance/guardrails.py
acceptance_criteria: Lifespan loads circuit breaker state alongside kill switches
CLI adapter strips sensitive env vars (API keys, DATABASE_URL, SECRET_KEY) from subprocess env
Temp workspaces are cleaned up on session termination
CLIBackendInfo has a build_args method, and _build_args in the adapter delegates to it
governance/guardrails.py has a deprecation notice pointing to nexus.guardrails
findings: All 749 tests pass (739 original + 10 new). Used subclass pattern for CLIBackendInfo to maintain backward-compatible build_args behavior while enabling extensibility. The _temp_workspace metadata flag distinguishes auto-created vs user-specified workspaces for safe cleanup. Cooldown auto-reset logic mirrors the in-memory CircuitBreaker pattern exactly.
